**Foundation Future Industries**, a robotics startup venture involving **Eric Trump**, has been awarded a $24 million contract with the **Pentagon**, the United States Department of Defense. The development has drawn criticism from some Democratic leaders, who have described it as “corruption in plain sight.” The company is set to begin testing its **“Phantom” humanoid robot** with the Marine Corps.

## Eric Trump-backed startup lands $24 million contract

Foundation Future Industries, a robotics startup backed by Eric Trump, [President Donald Trump’s](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/jimmy-kimmel-roasts-rfk-jr-132750918.html) son, has secured a multimillion-dollar defense contract from the Pentagon.

The Silicon Valley startup, which is reportedly developing its “Phantom” humanoid robot with the Marine Corps, has received a $24 million contract to test it (via [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/media/eric-trump-backed-robot-startup-lands-24m-pentagon-deal-compete-china)).

“We are America first. We have to win this race,” Eric Trump said about this, “We better be winning this race in the United States of America. We’re the greatest economy in the world.”

Several Democratic leaders criticized the deal, raising concerns about potential conflicts of interest. Elizabeth Warren reacted to the development in a post. She [wrote on her X](https://x.com/SenWarren/status/2047364063659712600), “Eric Trump went on FOX to brag about winning ANOTHER multimillion-dollar contract from the Trump administration. I’ve been sounding the alarm and pushing for answers.” She added, “Is the Pentagon just a cash machine for Trump’s kids now This looks like corruption in plain sight.”

Advertisement

“You can’t make this stuff up. The most corrupt first family of all time,” Ilhan Omar added, sharing the same clip as Warren [on X](https://x.com/IlhanMN/status/2047377940069908517).

This development comes less than a month after a Powerus executive told the [Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/trump-sons-powerus-drone-interceptors-iran-missiles-1d8d858fdad5104a56e4438994093594) that the company was pitching its technology to Gulf countries to address the risk of Iranian attacks. Eric Trump and his brother, Donald Trump Jr., back Powerus.

The development continues to draw discussion, particularly among critics of the current administration.

Meanwhile, tensions between the United States and Iran remain unresolved.

# Eric Trump-linked firm’s $24M Pentagon deal ignites corruption claims

A Pentagon decision to award a $24 million contract to Foundation Future Industries, where Eric Trump is chief strategy adviser, has triggered sharp criticism from Democratic lawmakers who allege corruption and conflicts of interest. The robotics startup will test humanoid robots with the Marine Corps as part of a broader Pentagon push into AI and autonomous warfare. The White House has dismissed the allegations as politically motivated attacks, insisting there are no conflicts of interest.

### Warren leads lawmaker outcry over Pentagon's $24M deal

Sen. Elizabeth Warren spearheaded criticism after Eric Trump appeared on Fox Business to tout Foundation Future Industries’ new $24 million Pentagon contract. Warren called it “corruption in plain sight” and questioned whether the Pentagon had become “a cash machine for Trump’s kids.” Other Democrats, including Reps. Ilhan Omar, Ruben Gallego, and Darren Soto, accused the Trump family of enriching themselves through military spending tied to the ongoing war in Iran. Benzinga + 2

[![WASHINGTON, DC - APRIL 06: Steve Witkoff, United States Special Envoy to the Middle East and Eric Trump (R) attend a news conference in James S. President Trump spoke about the successful military mission to rescue a weapons systems officer whose F-15E Strike Eagle was shot down in Iran. (Photo by Andrew Harnik/Getty Images) (Photo: Andrew Harnik via Getty Images)")

### Why the contract sparks ethics concerns

Critics point to a broader pattern of Trump family-linked firms securing lucrative government deals since Donald Trump returned to the presidency. Eric Trump and Donald Trump Jr. have held advisory or investment roles in companies that later received Pentagon contracts or loans, including drone maker Unusual Machines and rare earth firm Vulcan Elements. Commentators argue that Eric Trump’s lack of prior industry involvement and public boasting about the deal underscore the perception of conflicts of interest. Alternet + 1

### White House pushes back against allegations

White House spokesperson Anna Kelly dismissed the criticism as a decade-old partisan narrative, asserting that President Trump acts solely in the public interest. She insisted there are “no conflicts of interest” involving the president’s family and accused the media of fabricating claims to erode public trust. Similar denials have been issued regarding other Trump family investments, including those in the defense and technology sectors. Benzinga

### Pentagon's AI and robotics push

The $24 million award to Foundation Future Industries aligns with the Pentagon’s expanded focus on AI-powered military systems. The Defense Department’s fiscal 2027 budget request includes $55 billion for the Defense Autonomous Warfare Group, which develops robotics for combat and support roles. Foundation’s ‘Phantom’ humanoid robot will be tested with the Marine Corps, and Eric Trump has framed the project as part of a race to outpace China in advanced robotics. Alternet + 1

Credit: Drew Angerer/Getty_ ### NEED TO KNOW - Foundation Future Industries, a robotics startup connected to Eric Trump, one of President Donald Trump's sons, was recently awarded a $24 million contract with the Pentagon - The company is set to begin testing its “Phantom” humanoid robot with the Marine Corps, according to Fox Business - The Defense Department unveiled its fiscal 2027 budget request on Tuesday, April 21, including a $55 billion ask for the Defense Autonomous Warfare Group The Pentagon awarded a multi-million-dollar defense contract to a robotics startup affiliated with [Eric Trump](https://people.com/tag/eric-trump/), one of President [Donald Trump](https://people.com/tag/donald-trump/)'s sons, in a move panned by some Democrats as “corruption in plain sight.” [Foundation Future Industries](https://foundation.bot/), a Silicon Valley startup developing humanoid robots, landed the $24 million contract to test its “Phantom” android with the Marine Corps, according to a Thursday, April 23, [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/media/eric-trump-backed-robot-startup-lands-24m-pentagon-deal-compete-china) report. Company founder and CEO Sankaet Pathak appeared alongside Eric, Foundation's chief strategy advisor, on the network's _Mornings with Maria_ on Thursday to speak about the technology and similar advancements in China. “We are America first. We have to win this race,” Eric, 42, told host Maria Bartiromo on Thursday. “We better be winning this race in the United States of America. We're the greatest economy in the world.” The Defense Department [unveiled](https://www.war.gov/News/News-Stories/Article/Article/4465551/15-trillion-budget-request-prioritizes-service-members-modernization/) its fiscal 2027 budget request on Tuesday, April 21, including a $55 billion ask for the Defense Autonomous Warfare Group, tasked with researching and developing military robotics powered by artificial intelligence. The Pentagon's total budget request of $1.5 trillion is the largest in U.S. history. “Is the Pentagon just a cash machine for Trump's kids now?” Democratic Sen. [Elizabeth Warren](https://people.com/tag/elizabeth-warren/) wrote Thursday [on X](https://x.com/SenWarren/status/2047364063659712600), responding to a clip of Eric's Fox Business appearance. “This looks like corruption in plain sight.” Reacting to the same clip, Democratic Rep. [Ilhan Omar](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/trump-says-rep-ilhan-omar-220033520.html), a frequent target of the president, called the Trumps “the most corrupt first family of all time.” “You can't make this stuff up,” she wrote [on X](https://x.com/IlhanMN/status/2047377940069908517). The Pentagon did not immediately return PEOPLE's request for comment. Advertisement News of Foundation's contract with the Defense Department comes less than a month after an executive at Powerus, a Florida drone maker backed by Eric and [Donald Trump Jr.](https://people.com/tag/donald-trump-jr/), the president's eldest son, told the [Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/trump-sons-powerus-drone-interceptors-iran-missiles-1d8d858fdad5104a56e4438994093594) that the company was pitching its technology to Gulf countries susceptible to Iranian attacks. Fighting in the Middle Eastern nation broke out in February, after the U.S. and Israel carried out strikes [that killed Ayatollah Ali Khamenei](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/trump-says-irans-supreme-leader-225925741.html), Iran's former Supreme Leader. ![First Lady Melania Trump during the Fostering the Future Together Global Coalition Summit at the White House on March 25Credit: Heather Diehl/Getty](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/F9761203E3182EBF14F4F421D45483E43AABA99B4F6D2DDFC7CFEE02417F511B/subgraphmysterio/resizefit_w960_h640;quality_80;format_webp/https:%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Faol_people_articles_471%2Fa303f6190f150a6da89ca82fd0275dd8) _First Lady Melania Trump during the Fostering the Future Together Global Coalition Summit at the White House on March 25
Credit: Heather Diehl/Getty_ Trump's second administration has broadly embraced android technology, praising its use cases even beyond the battlefield. At a global technology summit in Washington last month, first lady Melania Trump [walked side by side with a humanoid robot](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/melania-trump-robot-join-forces-193128023.html) developed by [Figure AI](https://www.figure.ai/), another Northern California startup. The robot introduced itself to an audience at the White House as “Figure 03, a humanoid built in the United States of America,” and welcomed attendees in 11 languages. **_Never miss a story — sign up for_** [**_PEOPLE's free daily newsletter_**](https://people.com/people-news-daily-newsletter-sign-up-8692701) **_to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer​​, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories._** The two-day summit assembled leaders from more than three dozen countries, whom the first lady encouraged to be “catalyst\[s\] for discovery” by embracing emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence. “The future of AI is ‘personified' — it will be formed in the shape of humans,” she said. She added, “Very soon, artificial intelligence will move from our mobile phones to humanoids that deliver utility. Since our environment is designed for people, humanoid systems are uniquely suited to navigate and operate within our world. They ‘fit' well.” Read the original article on [People](https://people.com/eric-trump-backed-startup-lands-usd24-million-contract-from-his-father-administration-11957625) Show comments 0 Advertisement ## From Our Partners [![Advertisement](https://s.yimg.com/cv/apiv2/adbuilder/gemini.png)](https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/privacy/adinfo/index.html) Eric Trump-Backed Startup Lands $24 Million Contract from His Father's Administration - AOL

A company backed by President **Donald Trump's** son **Eric Trump** could cash in from a new contract from the Pentagon. The news has Sen. **Elizabeth Warren** (D-Mass.) questioning the contract and others involving the Trump family, her latest call-out against the president and his family.

## **Foundation Futures Industries Lands Pentagon Deal**

**Foundation Future Industries** is the latest company that has either Eric Trump, **Donald Trump Jr.** or both as advisors, that is landing either a [government contract or loan](https://www.benzinga.com/general/market-summary/25/04/44861732/unusual-machines-dominari-holdings-share-volume-spiked-ahead-of-trump-family-appointments-heres-what-happened?nid=52051856&utm_campaign=partner_feed&utm_content=site&utm_medium=partner_feed&utm_source=yahooFinance). The latest has caught the attention of the well-known senator after Eric Trump appeared on Fox News to discuss the deal.

Warren shared a tweet from journalist **Aaron Rupar.**

"Eric Trump — the president's son — is on Maria Bartiromo's show bragging about one of his companies landing a $24 million Pentagon contract," Rupar tweeted.

White House spokesperson **Anna Kelly** pushed back on the criticism in a statement to Benzinga.

“This is the same, tired narrative that Democrats have pushed against President Trump, his family, and his administration for a decade. President Trump only acts in the best interests of the American public – which is why they overwhelmingly re-elected him to this office, despite years of lies and false accusations against him and his businesses from the fake news media. There are no conflicts of interest,” Kelly said.

Trump joined Foundation Future Industries CEO **Sankaet Pahak** for the virtual interview on Fox's "Mornings with Maria."

"We are America First. We have to win this race," Trump said.

The duo highlighted the $24 million Pentagon award to test the company's humanoid robots.

"The uses are unlimited, and I think it's a very beautiful thing, but we must win this race," Trump added.

Trump put an emphasis on beating China when it comes to humanoid robots, drones and other advanced technology. The president's son said he invested in the company because of their robots and the necessity of needing to get ahead of China.

Publicly traded drone maker **Unusual Machines** saw shares soar after Donald Trump Jr. joined its advisory board, receiving stock as compensation, according to Citizens for Ethics. The company later secured an Army order for drone motors following his appointment.

Donald Trump Jr.'s **1789 Capital** is an investor in **Vulcan Elements,** a rare earth company that received a $620 million Pentagon loan. The loan helped boost the value of the company and Trump's stake, as reported by the Financial Times.

Both oldest Trump sons are also involved with Florida drone company **PowerUps**, which is hoping to land military contracts, according to a report from the Wall Street Journal.

Other publicly traded companies with ties to one or more of the Trump sons include **Dominari Holdings**, **New America Acquisition I Corp**, **PSQ Holdings**, **GrabAGun Digital Holdings** and **Trump Media & Technology Group**.

# Pentagon allocates $24 million for Phantom combat robots

![Pentagon allocates $24 million for Phantom combat robots](https://zamin.uz/uploads/posts/2026-04/zamin_pentagon-zakazal-boevyh-robotov-phantom_20260426_181932_02921e45.webp)

The US Department of Defense has signed a $24 million contract with Foundation Future Industries for the production of high-performance humanoid robots named Phantom. This was reported by FOX Business, citing sources in Washington. Inform.kz [reports](https://zamin.uz/index.php?do=go&url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5mb3JtLmt6L3J1L3BlbnRhZ29uLXpha2F6YWwtYm9ldmloLXJvYm90b3YtcGhhbnRvbS1jNzMxZTE%3D&lang=en) on this.

This startup, which specializes in the production of powerful robots on a global scale, is supported by Eric Trump, the son of the US President. The primary goal of the project is to achieve superiority in competition with China in the field of technology.

The combat machine is designed to infiltrate enemy facilities and save the lives of American soldiers. Company head Sanket Patxak and strategy advisor Eric Trump emphasized that this technology will ensure US superiority on the battlefield.

According to Patxak, China is also currently actively working on similar technologies in the direction of ground and air autonomy. Eric Trump stated that he has seen the robots in action and believes they will fundamentally change the course of military operations.

The Phantom robot weighs 79 kilograms and can move at a speed of 1.7 meters per second. It is planned to use this technology not only in the defense sector but also in construction and disaster relief efforts.
